about: The one place a model is named (decision 0008, issue #103, on the 18 September consensus in juku-library/). Every other file asks for a role. How to ask, inspect and switch: library/model-registry.md. A switch is one edit to this file, reviewed like any other change to the gate, unless the pinned reviewer tool does not know the new model: then the pin moves in both reviewers too, proved first on a full-size read (#130). The reviewer roles are decision 0008's own assignment, except that no reader is the lead's own model, and since his ruling of 30 September GLM 5.3 at max reads the risky classes too. Since his rulings of 5 and 6 October 2026 only open-weight models review and nothing stands behind GLM: when it does not answer, the commit stays unread, the Chairman is told at once, and the work is to find why the connection to GLM was lost and fix it. The reviewer roles' effort is the Chairman's ruling of 28 September 2026, every read at max. The max-subagent role is what every product's max subagent file is set to, his ruling of the same day (library/max-subagent.md).

anthropic.note: Called through the Claude Code tool pinned in the reviewer workflows, on the Chairman's Claude subscription token.

openrouter.note: First provider, not the only one: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (a LiteLLM proxy, a direct provider) is a new entry here and nothing else. No model list is sent, so OpenRouter never substitutes another model; the caller also refuses an answer from any model but the one pinned. data_collection deny keeps a product's private code off providers that store it.

claude-sonnet-5-5.name: Claude Sonnet 5.5
claude-sonnet-5-5.source: Proved before it merged (#130's two reads): on 29 September 2026 a replica of a full risky read (this pull request's diff and every .md/.sh/.py/.yml file whole, 651,863 bytes; review.yml's system prompt and schema; -p --model claude-sonnet-5-5 --effort max --tools "" --restricted --strict-mcp-config --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --permission-prompts none --output-format json --json-schema --system-prompt) failed on Claude Code 2.1.280, which does not know the model (unrecognized_model at compaction; no verdict after 1,009 s), and answered on 2.1.285: success, verdict advisory, 1,330 s, USD 4.10. The 2.1.280 run saw a 200,000-token window for this model and compacted; the 2.1.285 run saw 1,000,000, took all 484,810 input tokens into context whole (cache creation), logged nothing, and did not compact. So both reviewers pin 2.1.285 and give a read 40 minutes. Run on the build session's credential on his account, not the reviewer environment's token

z-ai/glm-5.3.name: GLM 5.3
z-ai/glm-5.3.limits_note: Every cash request carries max_tokens at max_output_tokens and provider.max_price at price_usd_per_million, so its most is known before it is sent (decision 0014, D). A price here below the provider's refuses the request rather than paying more; max_output_tokens is a ceiling set on 5 October 2026 above what a review should write, not a measured figure.

reviewer-main.use: Reads every ordinary change: pages and ordinary code (decision 0008, rule 2). Nothing stands behind it: if it does not answer, the commit stays unread and the Chairman is told.

reviewer-risky.use: Reads every change in a risky class, always whole (decision 0008, rule 1), on GLM 5.3 at max (his ruling, 30 September 2026: "GLM 5.3 at max should also be the lead reviewer for risky changes."). Nothing stands behind it (his rulings of 5 and 6 October 2026: "Sonnet should not be used for a fallback review from now on. Only open weight models should be used as reviews." and "I don't want to have a backup if GLM is down because GLM is currently the only LLM that wins on a cost to price ratio therefore if GLM is down, I need you to inform me immediately and the protocol should be that we figure out why we lost connection to GLM and fix that."). If it does not answer, the commit stays unread and the Chairman is told.

reviewer-frontend.use: Final front-end and design review. No caller yet: a product UI change calls it in a later pull request.

coder-fast.use: Default high-volume implementation. No caller yet: the builder is a Claude or Codex session.

frontend-fast.use: Cheap front-end iteration before final review. No caller yet.

frontend-max.use: Final, design-sensitive UI generation. No caller yet.

agent-fast.use: Fast terminal and tool-use agent work. No caller yet.

max-subagent.use: The effort ladder's max step: the project subagent every product carries as .claude/agents/max-subagent.md, whose model and effort are this role's (library/max-subagent.md; his ruling, 28 September 2026). No fallback: a product's file names one model.
